digest.component_or_area: DC backend characterization suite and unit test coverage
propositions: Data Center backend has no value-pinning characterization suite; only Cloud's hardcoded JiraBackend path is tested for specific values, leaving DC's separate implementations (_DCOutbound, _DCInbound, _DCSanitizer) with only shape assertions that pass despite wrong values.

The create-path field mapper _map_local_to_dc_fields must be pinned by exact value for all emitted keys (summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee) including default-fallback branches (Task, Medium, To Do) and empty-string fallbacks.
DC's sanitizer boundaries for summary, description, and comment must be pinned at exact limits and one-over, including truncation suffix marker behavior.

The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote exercised through WikiTextCodec must pin description truncation to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT, non-str passthrough, and correct title/status/priority mapping without asserting fit-then-normalize ordering (which is unobservable through WikiTextCodec's identity normalization).

DC probe branches (PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE) must be pinned through the real classifier (classify_probe_response or JiraDataCenterTransport stub), not through FakeTransport which unconditionally returns UNREACHABLE.

DC must provably bind its own configured resolved_statuses rather than Cloud's; pins must use a non-default custom set (e.g. frozenset({'Custom Resolved'})) to distinguish DC's behavior from Cloud's identical default, avoiding vacuous tests.
